Tab1Text1:
For nearly 3 years we have been the top Fibercraft server, and we plan to stay there, improving along the way.

That is why we are the first server ever on this version of ARK to reward you for the time you play: playing on our servers earns you points you can spend on rewards. Click Playtime Rewards at the top to see what you can get. Points only count while you are actually playing, not while you stand AFK.

What to expect:
- High pop and a lot of competition
- A combined £400 cash prize pool for Cluster Alpha at the end of the season: £300 for 10-man tribes, £100 for trios

Server info and rules: the tabs at the top.
Cluster Alpha rules: join our Discord with the button in the bottom left.

Good luck and have fun!

Tab2Text2:
- No Hard-R or doxing, in game or on Discord: Discord + cluster ban.
- No meshing: the servers get rolled back to find the meshers, followed by a Discord + cluster ban.
- No cheating or duping: no cheat engines (Headshot, Unleashed, Primal, ERGE etc.), no scripts to spoof or gain an unfair advantage, no RDP. INI is allowed.
- No alt accounts (unless staff knows a valid reason): the alt and every account connected to it get banned.
- No insiding: banned when there is proof (logs alone are not proof).
- No teaming: raiding with another tribe without killing each other gets both tribes structure-wiped (we need clips, logs are not enough).
- No raiding without a base on the main cluster. Raiding off your private risks your private being shut down.
- No buying or selling tames for items or real money: Discord + cluster ban for everyone involved.
- No mutagen exploiting.

ARK is a game of glitches, exploits, cheaters and frustration. Please don't open tickets for simply getting ARKED.
Tab2Text3:
- Max 2 bases per map.
- Don't block cave entrances with structures or dinos: stay 2 foundations away from the entry point.
- No building at or on obelisks (the Valguero green obelisk is fine if you build in the cave).
- No turrets at spawn points, boss fights or beaver dams.
- Turret limit: 500 single turrets (ground, foundations, cliff plats and walls all count).
- Teleporters and turrets around the map must be covered by a bubble. No bubble = teleporter wiped.
- No floating turrets on trapdoors or hatchframes.
- No border snapping, basi bombing, sino raiding, fully boxed platform dinos, cannon raiding or tunneling into bases.
- Spam: don't excessively spam structures in one location. Building purely to lag, block or exploit mechanics is spam. Spam and meshed structures are removed by AOE, which can hit other structures too.
- Max 5 tames soaking in a row, or they get redgunned and your FOB wiped. Raid tames don't count: Athros (max 30), Pelagornis, Griffins, Baryonyx.
- Tower tame limit: max 15 tames in a cage, wall or fortnite.
- Small/medium cave tunnels: max 5 medium or 10 small dinos. No Lightning Wyverns at cave edit entrances. Big tunnels: the same amount per 20-foundation radius.
- 6x damage caves: no Stryders, whales or Astrodelphis. Mammoths only for the buff (breaking structures = timed ban).
